meta.preferred_model_role: illustrative central scenario (not an identified estimator)
meta.deaths_2023_note: Canonical scripts use 117739 (Indicadores 2025). Anuario table 3.13 may show 117746 — do not mix in one sum.
meta.deaths_2022_2025_note: Identity window sum 502149 (model_from_2021). Model E death JSON sums 502159 — internal reconstruction path only.
meta.primary_uncertainty: across-scenario envelope A–C/D (~1.8–2.4M loss), not within-D percentiles

model_d_path_m.note: 2030 point is illustrative scenario only, not a forecast.

model_d.loss_90_note: Prior-predictive under fixed Model D margins — not sampling error from data.
model_d.definition_loss_pct: Percent decline uses corrected end-2021 base (official minus baseline overstatement U0), not raw official 11.11M.
model_d.onei_anchored_M1_note: If M=1 (ONEI R only) and U0 modest, living population sits nearer ~9.0–9.2M (Model A neighbourhood).

register_gap_official_2021_to_end_2026.note: Register gap vs official 2021 stock — not interchangeable with Model D −20.5%. Do not lead the scientific abstract with this figure.

provisional_schedule_residual_2024_2025.status: provisional — coarse 2019 CDR bridge; refine with full age-sex cells
provisional_schedule_residual_2024_2025.method: Registered minus expected deaths: 2019 total deaths / 2019 population × year-t population (ONEI 3.15 + claims population path).
provisional_schedule_residual_2024_2025.note: Do not call this a Kitagawa decomposition or the primary scientific claim. Primary headcount uncertainty remains the migration scenario envelope.

excess_mortality.note: Always label crude vs schedule residual. Windows differ (2020–2025 vs 2024–2025).

selectivity.emigrants_age_15_59_source: ONEI emigration bulletins / Albizu-Campos (2023–2024) synthesis; see data/selectivity.yaml
selectivity.pct_age_60_plus_note: 26.7% is official structure; Model-D-consistent share would be higher — treat as official, not D-consistent.
selectivity.female_share_note: Manuscript uses majority-female wording only; exact share not recomputed from ONEI microdata in this repo.
selectivity.reproductive_age_ratio_note: Prior essay cited ~133:100 from external flow tables; omitted from EN preprint until sourced in selectivity.yaml.

models_summary.label: D · sentinel
models_summary.assumption: IMR consistency check + migration priors near B

models_summary.label: E · vital reconstruction (HSDS)
models_summary.assumption: ageing + health decadence + bad reporting → B*, D*, P*

model_e.definition: Vital reconstruction via HSDS; provisional. Higher stock vs D is partly a different U0 prior — not independent confirmation.

triangulation.note: Model D is the study estimand and must not appear as external validation of itself. Albizu/housing share exit-correcting assumptions with the migration narrative — soft independence only.

destinations_settled.assert_sum: us + non_us_total == floor_total; spain + uruguay + rest == non_us_total
destinations_settled.us_construction_note: Admin-status / CBP-pipeline settled approximation — not ACS Cuban-born stock. ACS rise 2019→2024 is smaller (~+0.34M); treat 0.80M as an administrative ceiling/floor hybrid.
destinations_settled.note: Settled-concept floor only — not encounters or nationality applications. Mostly 2020–2025 exits. Periods misalign with ONEI R (2022–2025).

destinations_other_concepts.note: Do not mix with settled ledger without labeling. Encounters ≈ events; ACS ≈ stock change; admin settled ≈ statuses.

migration_bridge.note: Only the floor is ledger-like. 1.05→1.5 is an unquantified residual; 1.5→2.0 is Model D prior M on R, not destination microdata.
migration_bridge.u0_M_budget_note: U0 and (M-1)R can double-count the same register lag; report ONEI-anchored (M≈1) beside D.
